title: 세탁실과 관리실
purpose: Full original easy instance partitioned between two actors; no puzzle/entity omission.

rules.goal: Complete the original escape mechanism together.
rules.navigation: One move to any owned scene reachable in the original visible scene graph from its start. Free traversal is collapsed; original gates remain.
rules.communication: Explicit free-text send only; source papers remain transferable tools.
rules.hatch: Pass held tools from any area.
rules.environmental_links: Original cross-room mechanical unlocks are retained and audited.
rules.scheduling: Explicit actor, no model or budget scheduler.

scenes.name: laundry room overview
scenes.desc: The entrance of the laundry room, there's an office room on the left side, and two rows of washing and drying machines in the front. Each side of the room has a corridor. There's also a vending machine right in front of you.

scenes.name: left corridor overview
scenes.desc: The left corridor of the laundry room. A row of drying machine is now on your right. There's an office door on the left. The corridor leads to a game booth.

scenes.name: end of left corridor
scenes.desc: There's a game booth on the left, and drying machine still on your right. In the front is a vacant space with air vent hanging high above and green plant below.

scenes.name: laundry room left corner
scenes.desc: The left corner of the laundry room. There's a coffee table in the corner, some newspaper on the coffee table, and a drink vending machine beside.

scenes.name: laundry room right corner
scenes.desc: The right corner of the laundry room. There's a row of seats beside the wall, a green plant at the corner. The floor is clean.

scenes.name: right corridor overview
scenes.desc: The right corridor of the laundry room. There's a row of drying machine on your left now, and a row of washing machine on your right. The corridor leads to a table in the front.

scenes.name: end of right corridor
scenes.desc: There's a table right in fron of you. A door is on the left but locked. A TV is hanging high above the wall in the corner.

scenes.name: office room overview
scenes.desc: A messy office room with paper over grounds. An iron gate is in the front, and some cabinates on the right side.

scenes.name: office room right side
scenes.desc: The right side of the office room. There's a desk in the front, drawers below the desk, and some cabinates of the left side. An electric control box is on the wall, with a chair beside.

entities.name: vending machine

states.desc: An old vending machine with three items on the list, each worth 0.5 dollar, The machine only receives coins.
states.neg_reward: You may put your coins at hand to see what will come out. Make sure you have already exchanged the money to coins.

transitions.reward: A soap drop out from the machine, and returns you some coins. You have 1.5 dollars remaining.

entities.position: Hanging on the wall in the front

entities.name: soap

states.desc: a brand new soap, white and very slippery, might be used to lubricate things

entities.position: In the output box of vending machine

entities.name: drying machine

states.desc: The drying machine with lid closed now. There's a money receiver (coin only) on the right, and a control panel now showing 1.5 dollar.
states.neg_reward: It only receives coins of exact amount, you should put in the coin if you have exactly total amount 1.5 dollars at hand.

transitions.reward: The lid of the machine opens, and there's a yellow key card inside.

states.desc: The drying machine, now with the lid open.

entities.position: On the right of the corridor

entities.name: red mail box

states.desc: The mail box is locked with a 4-digit password. The hint beside the lock writes 'II I I/II I-II', corresponding to the 4 digits.
states.neg_reward: You should try to figure the code out by first knowing what I and II represents, find hints about it.

transitions.reward: The mail box opens, and there drops a safe handle.

states.desc: The mail box is open.

entities.position: Hanging on the wall left of office door

states.desc: The paper writes "1 4 2 3 +", seems left part of an equation hint. Find its right part to form the whole hint.
states.neg_reward: You cannot take it with you, but you may remember it and combine it with another hint to complete it.

entities.name: office door password pad

states.desc: The pad requires to input a 4-digit number to open the office door.
states.neg_reward: Try to get the paper pieces that hint on this 4-digit code, you may need to combine two hints in your bag together.

trigger: change_visible, scene, office room overview, True
transitions.reward: The office door opens, you could get in now.

entities.position: Hanging on the wall right of office door

states.desc: a yellow key card with a small round metal disk on its head, seems used to open something
a silver safe handle made of metal
A fancy game machine currently turned on, with 'insert ticket' written on the screen.
states.neg_reward: You may find a ticket to run the game and play it.

transitions.reward: You start playing the game. You achieve top 1 and the screen shows your score is 5974.

states.desc: The screen shows you achieve top 1 with a score of 5974.

entities.name: tool box

states.desc: A red tool box with a 4-digit password lock. There's only 4 choices 1, 2, 3 or 4 for each digit, e.g. 2343 (just example input, not correct).
states.neg_reward: You should only use 1, 2, 3, 4 in your password input. Use the equation hint to solve this.

transitions.reward: The tool box is open, there's a nozzle inside

states.desc: The tool box is now open.

entities.position: On the ground beside drying machine

states.desc: A silver metal pipe tightened on the drying machine, originally used to deliver water.
states.neg_reward: You may want to use the pipe later, try to get it off with tool in your bag.

transitions.reward: The pipe is unscrewed from the machine, you can collect it now.

entities.name: air vent

states.desc: A white air vent, it's too high to be reached now.
states.neg_reward: You should put something on the ground to try to reach the vent.

transitions.reward: You could now reach the vent.

states.desc: A white air vent, now you could reach it. There's a port beside, with fresh air coming out, seems used for filling.
states.neg_reward: The air vent could help fill in gas, but something used to deliver gas should be installed to the container first.

transitions.reward: The gas tank is now filled with gas, the air pressure is enough now.

states.desc: A white air vent, now continuously giving fresh air.

entities.position: High on the wall in the front

states.desc: a nozzle with a silver mouth, seems should connect with something else to control and work.
a silver metal pipe with that could connect ends together
a game ticket that writes 'car racing', made of normal paper
The zip of the handbag is rusty, hard to open directly.
states.neg_reward: You may find a way to lubricate the zip before opening it.

transitions.reward: The zip is now lubricated with soap foam all over it.

states.desc: The zip of the handbag is all over soap foam, easy to open now.
states.neg_reward: You may simply interact with the bag to open it.

transitions.reward: You open the handbag, and there's a piler inside.

states.desc: The hand bag is now open.

entities.name: information board

states.desc: An information board has a lock on outer glass door. There's a lock at the bottom requiring 4-digit password. On the wall writes 'top 1'.
states.neg_reward: You should think about what 4-digit hint is related to top 1 and hints related to it.

trigger: change_visible, tool, left half paper, True
transitions.reward: The window of the information board is now open. There's lots of notice inside.

states.desc: The information board is now open.

entities.position: Hanging on the right side wall

states.desc: A pot culture, green plant growing in the soil. The soil seems a bit loose.
states.neg_reward: You may find out what's inside the soil by simply interacting with it.

transitions.reward: You dig into the soil and find a gold key hidden beneath.

states.desc: A pot culture with soild being digged.

entities.name: hanger

states.desc: A hanger made of wood, a rag haning on it. The bolts seems a bit loose.
states.neg_reward: There may be something behind, you may further pull the hanger down (loose the screw) with a tool.

transitions.reward: The hanger is pulled down, and there's a piece of paper inside the wall behind.

states.desc: A hanger currently pulled down, showing a hidden space behind.

entities.position: On the wall in the front

states.desc: A money exchange machine that gives coins according to input bill amount.
states.neg_reward: You may input money and get coins from here. You should do it after the bill is dry.

transitions.reward: Two coins come out the machine, each worth 1 dollar.

states.desc: A money exchanger that works normally.
a piler with red handle and metal head
Left side intact, right side seems torned, with '58' written on it.
Right side intact, left side seems torned, with '91' written on it.

entities.name: gold key

states.desc: a normal key made of metal, shining golden light.

entities.position: Inside the soil of pot culture

entities.name: code paper

states.desc: A code paper writes '4 2 1 3 (mod 4)', seems part of a about an equation.

entities.position: Behind the hanger in the wall

entities.name: dollar coins

states.desc: Two coins, each worth 1 dollar. In total 2 dollars.
Two coins, with one worth 1 dollar, another one worth 0.5 dollar, in total 1.5 dollar left.

entities.position: In the output box of money exchanger

states.desc: A blue basin with water inside.
states.neg_reward: You could soak things inside this basin.

transitions.reward: The clothes is now wet after soaking in the water.

entities.name: graffiti

states.desc: There seems grafitti on the wall but now something dirty is over it, you cannot see clearly. You cannot directly reach the graffiti as it's too high.
states.neg_reward: Try wipe out the dirty things using something long and wet to reach it.

transitions.reward: The dirty things over graffiti is wiped out, you see some characters on the wall.

states.desc: The graffiti writes 'I - 9, II - 1, III - 4, IV - 2, ...' It seems like code hint to something.

entities.position: High on the wall over washing machine

entities.name: dollar bill

states.desc: a wet 2 dollar bill, still intact, but cannot be used if not dry
a dry 2 dollar bill, now usable

entities.position: Inside the blue basin on drying machine

states.desc: a white shirt currenly clean and dry
a white shirt currenly wet, soaked with water
The plug with a electric cable, not in the socket beside now.
states.neg_reward: You may simply interact to get the plug into the socket to power on things above the table.

transitions.reward: You plug it into the socket, now electricity is on.

states.desc: The plug is now in the socket.
An electric cable is linked to it. The iron is currently out of power.
states.neg_reward: You may first give it power by plugging in the cable and plug first under the desk.

states.desc: The iron is turned on with power, usable now.
states.neg_reward: You may use the iron to dry things.

transitions.reward: The dollar bill is dry and flat to use now.

states.desc: A normal iron, used to dry dollar before.
An iron gate with a golden key hole in the right middle, closed currently. You can see there's a ladder inside.
states.neg_reward: You may try to open this iron gate with a matched key (pay attention to color).

transitions.reward: The iron gate is open, you could get inside now and retrieve the ladder.

states.desc: The iron gate is open.
An safe made of metal, but missing handles currently. You cannot open it directly. It in total needs two handles.
states.neg_reward: You should first find the two handles and assemble them both first.

transitions.reward: Two handles are assembled, the safe could be opened now.

states.desc: The safe with two handles assembled, it could be opened now through simple interaction.
states.neg_reward: You should simply interact to open the safe.

transitions.reward: You open the safe, there's a drawing and a wrench inside.

states.desc: The safe is open now.
A metal fence gate is welded to the ventilation pipe on the wall near ground. There's no air coming from inside.
states.neg_reward: The pipe's width could even fit the body. You may try to break open this mental fence through gas burning its edge.

transitions.reward: The mental fence is off, you could escape from here now. GAME END!

a wrench that could tighten or loosen screws
a drawing featuring a green plant above, soil under it, and under the soil there's a key. Seems a hint to where to find the key.
A wooden drawer with a digital lock. There's a metal round shape thing beside the handle, like a card reader.
states.neg_reward: You should try to open this drawer with a matched tool in bag for authorization.

states.desc: The drawer is now open
a silver safe handle made of metal
a wood besom with long handle, its head already broken and needs to be wrapped by some cloth
a wood besom with long handle, its head now wrapped with wet clothes for mopping
an empty metal gas tank with a connection port on the top, needs to be connected with something
an empty metal gas tank, currently connected with a pipe on the top, needs gas filling
a gas tank full of flammable air inside, currently connected with a pipe on the top, but missing a mouth for control
a gas tank full of flammable air, connected to the nozzle through a pipe, ready to produce heat to burn things now.

modifications: All original scenes, entities, descriptions, initial visibility, tool uses, and transitions retained.
Scenes are allocated to A/B; freely traversable paths collapse into one move.
Original remote mechanical effects retained. Each actor observes only their own scenes.
The original terminal mechanism opens the shared team escape; no added exit puzzle.
Reference adds exploration of input clues, messages, movement and required object handoffs.
